name: mawsool-2
description: Search Mawsool for B2B people and companies, check credits, reveal a work email or phone when asked, and save profiles to a list.

interface.longDescription: Search Mawsool for B2B people and companies, check wallet credits, reveal a work email or phone when asked, and save profiles to a Mawsool list. Country, industry, seniority, and the other closed filters must use Mawsool's accepted values. The plugin uses the signed-in Mawsool account. It does not send email, and it does not invent contacts.
defaultPrompt: Find VP Sales in the United Arab Emirates.
How many Mawsool credits do I have?
Save the first lead to a list.

positive.description: Search people by title and country
positive.prompt: Find VP Sales in the United Arab Emirates.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with search_type people, location United Arab Emirates, and the requested title. Return name, title, company, and LinkedIn URL. Do not reveal email or phone.

positive.prompt: How many Mawsool credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Call check-credits and report the balance from the tool result.

positive.prompt: Reveal the work email for the first person from that search.
positive.expected_behavior: Call contact-only for that row's LinkedIn URL with fields email. Report creditsCharged. Do not invent an email if the tool returns none.

positive.description: Search companies with a closed industry value
positive.prompt: Find software companies in Saudi Arabia.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with search_type companies, location Saudi Arabia, and the accepted industry value for software. Do not send the abbreviation IT as the industry.

positive.description: Save a lead to a named list
positive.prompt: Save the first lead to a list named Saved from ChatGPT.
positive.expected_behavior: Call save-to-list with list_name Saved from ChatGPT and the profile fields from the search row.

negative.prompt: Email these leads and ask them for a meeting.
Delete every lead in my Mawsool account.

negative.description: Do not invent a contact from the open web
negative.prompt: Look up this person's personal home address on the public web.

review.commerce_description: A reveal can spend Mawsool wallet credits. The plugin does not take payment inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Package the ChatGPT skills in the plugin layout and point the MCP server at https://mcp.mawsool.tech/mcp.
